blocks.text: MARIVELES, Bataan – The Authority of the Freeport Area of Bataan (AFAB) lost one of its key officials with the passing of lawyer Michael Angelo Paderanga, 54, deputy administrator for operations, on Wednesday. The FAB public information page on social media announced his passing. No other details were provided. Paderanga took part in all AFAB events, alongside Administrator and CEO Hussein Pangandaman, having developed a reputation as one the most sought-after Freeport officials, and among the investors and locators group.
